items.title: 63519_Wild Bill Davison oral history interview
items.q: we got him and we had a guy - another saxophone player

ctx.x: Yeah and I had Slim Evans from the old days -- he was with the---
His name was Neirouter------ Otis Neirouter.

Yeah but they called him Slim Evans-- he got rid of that Neirouter thing-- and he was in Chicago so we got him and we had a guy - another saxophone player -- [Kensel C.] Toasty Paul who played alto, and first alto was Teshmacher and he played clarinet too and they all played clarinet - as a matter of fact.
